docs.title: Order #58213
docs.text:
To: Martin Reyes <mreyes@solanocafe.com>
From: Hannah Liu <hliu@pacificpaperware.com>
Date: April 8
Subject: Order #58213

Dear Mr. Reyes,

I am writing about your order of 5,000 compostable coffee cups, which was scheduled to ship today. Unfortunately, our factory had to stop production for two days last week after a machine broke down, and we are now behind schedule. Your order will ship on April 15 instead.

I understand that you are opening a second café on April 12 and may need the cups before then. If so, we can send 1,000 cups from our current stock by express delivery at no extra cost. They are the same size, but they have a plain white design instead of your printed logo. The remaining 4,000 printed cups would follow on April 15.

Please let me know by tomorrow afternoon which option you prefer.

Best regards,
Hannah Liu
Customer Service, Pacific Paperware

options: To confirm that an order has been delivered
To explain why a shipment will be late
To request payment for an invoice
To announce a new product line

Print a logo on plain cups
Give a discount on a future order
Send some cups quickly at no charge

questions.q: What is suggested about Mr. Reyes?

questions.explain: Email nhắc 'you are opening a second café on April 12' — ông ấy đang mở rộng kinh doanh.

docs.title: City approves bike-share program
docs.text:
GREENVILLE (March 3) — The Greenville City Council voted on Tuesday to launch a bike-share program this summer. [1] Under the plan, 300 bicycles will be placed at 40 stations across the downtown area and near the university campus.

Users will be able to rent a bike through a mobile app for $2 per half hour or buy an annual pass for $60. [2] The program will be run by CycleNow, a company that operates similar systems in six other cities.

Council member Teresa Ward, who proposed the plan, said it would reduce traffic and help residents who do not own cars. "Many people live within three miles of where they work," she said. "For them, a bike is often faster than a bus." [3]

Not everyone supports the idea. Some downtown business owners worry that the stations will take away parking spaces. [4] The council has promised to review the station locations with these owners before installation begins in May.

questions.q: How much does an annual pass cost?
questions.explain: Đoạn 2: 'buy an annual pass for $60'.

questions.q: What is indicated about CycleNow?
options: It was founded by Ms. Ward.
It manages bike-share programs in other cities.
questions.explain: Đoạn 2: CycleNow là 'a company that operates similar systems in six other cities'.

questions.q: What concern do some business owners have?
questions.explain: Đoạn 4: chủ doanh nghiệp lo rằng các trạm xe 'will take away parking spaces' — chỗ đỗ xe sẽ giảm.

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Students and seniors will receive a 25 percent discount on passes."
questions.explain: Câu về giảm giá vé phù hợp ngay sau câu nói về giá thuê và vé năm ($2, $60) ở vị trí [2].

docs.title: Flexible working hours
docs.text:
MEMO
To: All employees
From: Rachel Brooks, Human Resources
Date: January 6
Subject: Flexible working hours

Following the positive results of last year's trial in the accounting department, Vantor Insurance will introduce flexible working hours for all office staff beginning February 3. [1]

Under the new policy, employees may start work at any time between 7:00 and 10:00 A.M., provided that they complete eight hours each day. All staff must be present during our "core hours" of 10:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M. [2]

Employees who wish to change their schedule must submit a request form to their manager by January 24. [3] Managers will try to approve all requests, but they may ask some employees to adjust their hours to make sure that each team has enough coverage.

A detailed guide is attached to this memo. [4]

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To announce a change in work schedules
To introduce a new department manager
To report the results of a survey
To explain a new insurance policy
questions.explain: Đoạn 1: công ty sẽ áp dụng giờ làm việc linh hoạt cho toàn bộ nhân viên văn phòng từ 3/2.

questions.q: By when must employees submit a request?
questions.explain: Đoạn 3: 'must submit a request form to their manager by January 24'.

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"This is when most team meetings and client calls take place."
questions.explain: 'This is when...' giải thích lý do của 'core hours' 10:00–15:00, nên đặt ngay sau câu đó ở vị trí [2].

Our evening program allows working professionals to build new skills without leaving their jobs. Classes meet once a week from 6:30 to 9:00 P.M. for ten weeks, starting September 15.

docs.title: Riverside Hotel reopens after major renovation
docs.text:
Riverside Hotel Reopens After Major Renovation
By Michelle Grant

PORTLAND — After eighteen months of construction, the historic Riverside Hotel reopened its doors last Friday. The 110-year-old building, which overlooks the Willamette River, now has 140 guest rooms, up from 96 before the renovation. [1]

The project cost an estimated $42 million and was led by architect Samuel Ito, who is known for his work restoring older buildings. "Our goal was to keep the character of the original hotel while making it comfortable for today's travelers," Mr. Ito said. [2] Workers carefully repaired the marble floors in the lobby and restored the large windows facing the river.

New features include a rooftop restaurant, a business center, and meeting rooms that can hold up to 300 people. [3] General manager Olivia Chen said that the hotel has already received bookings for several conferences next spring.

Room rates start at $189 per night. [4]

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
questions.explain: Tiêu đề và câu đầu: khách sạn Riverside mở cửa trở lại sau 18 tháng cải tạo.

questions.q: How many rooms did the hotel have before the renovation?
questions.explain: Đoạn 1: 'now has 140 guest rooms, up from 96 before the renovation'.

questions.q: What is NOT mentioned as a new feature of the hotel?
questions.explain: Đoạn 3 liệt kê nhà hàng sân thượng, trung tâm thương vụ và phòng họp; không có hồ bơi.

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"The additional rooms were created by using space that had once been offices."
questions.explain: 'The additional rooms' nhắc lại việc số phòng tăng từ 96 lên 140, nên đặt ngay sau câu đó ở vị trí [1].

docs.title: MetroLink Blue Line service changes
docs.text:
ATTENTION ALL PASSENGERS
MetroLink Rail — Service Changes on the Blue Line

From Saturday, August 2, to Sunday, August 10, there will be no train service between Central Station and Elmwood Station due to track maintenance. Free shuttle buses will replace trains on this section of the line. Buses will leave from the stops marked with yellow signs outside each station every 10 minutes.

Please allow up to 25 minutes of extra travel time. Trains will continue to run as usual between Elmwood Station and Airport Station.

Passengers with bicycles should note that shuttle buses cannot carry bikes. We apologize for the inconvenience.

For real-time updates, download the MetroLink app or follow us on social media.

docs.title: Lumen Home Appliances FAQ
docs.text:
Lumen Home Appliances — Frequently Asked Questions

How long is the warranty on Lumen products?
All Lumen appliances come with a two-year warranty that covers parts and labor. Refrigerators and washing machines also have a ten-year warranty on the motor.

Do I need to register my product?
Registration is not required for warranty service, but we recommend it. Registered customers receive reminders about filter changes and are notified of any safety recalls.

What should I do if my appliance stops working?
First, check the troubleshooting section of your user manual. If the problem continues, contact our service center at 1-800-555-0110 or submit a request online. Please have your model number and proof of purchase ready.

Can I extend my warranty?
Yes. Within 60 days of purchase, you may buy a Lumen Care plan, which extends coverage for up to three additional years.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the Web page?
options: To explain how to install an appliance
questions.explain: Tiêu đề 'Frequently Asked Questions' — trang trả lời các câu hỏi thường gặp của khách hàng.

questions.q: According to the Web page, what is a benefit of registering a product?
questions.explain: Khách đã đăng ký 'are notified of any safety recalls' — được thông báo về thu hồi sản phẩm.

questions.q: What is suggested about the Lumen Care plan?
options: It is included with every purchase.
It cannot be purchased several months after buying a product.
questions.explain: Gói Lumen Care chỉ mua được 'within 60 days of purchase', nên sau vài tháng thì không mua được nữa.

docs.title: New point-of-sale system
docs.text:
MEMO
To: Kitchen and dining staff
From: Andre Collins, Restaurant Manager
Date: March 18
Re: New point-of-sale system

On Monday, March 25, we will replace our old cash registers with a tablet-based ordering system. Servers will enter orders at the table, and the orders will appear immediately on a screen in the kitchen. This should reduce errors and shorten waiting times for our guests.

A representative from the software company will lead two training sessions on Saturday, March 23, at 9:00 A.M. and 3:00 P.M., before and after the lunch shift. Attendance at one session is required for all servers and kitchen staff. You will be paid for the time.

Please sign up for a session on the sheet next to the staff room door.

questions.q: What is one reason for the change?
options: To attract more customers at lunch
questions.explain: Đoạn 1: hệ thống mới 'should reduce errors and shorten waiting times'.

questions.q: What are employees asked to do?
questions.explain: Câu cuối: 'Please sign up for a session' — đăng ký một trong hai buổi đào tạo (9:00 hoặc 15:00).

docs.title: Office move
docs.text:
To: All Staff
From: Thomas Reed, Office Manager
Date: June 4
Subject: Office move

Hello everyone,

As you know, our team will move to the new office on Bayview Avenue at the end of this month. [1] The movers will arrive on Friday, June 28, at 4:00 P.M., and the new office will be ready for work on Monday, July 1.

Before the move, please pack the contents of your desk into the boxes that will be delivered next week. [2] Label each box with your name and your new desk number, which you will find on the attached floor plan.

Computers and monitors will be moved by our IT staff, so please do not pack them yourself. [3] Simply turn them off and unplug all cables before you leave on Friday.

If you have any items that you no longer need, please put them in the recycling area by the kitchen. [4]

Thank you for your cooperation.
Thomas

questions.q: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
options: To ask for volunteers to help with a move
To give instructions for an office move
To announce the opening of a new branch
questions.explain: Email hướng dẫn nhân viên đóng thùng, dán nhãn và xử lý máy tính trước khi chuyển văn phòng.

questions.q: What should employees do with their computers?
options: Turn them off and disconnect them
Bring them to the new office
Give them to the recycling area
questions.explain: Đoạn 4: 'Simply turn them off and unplug all cables before you leave on Friday'.

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"They will be connected and tested over the weekend."
questions.explain: 'They' chỉ máy tính và màn hình do bộ phận IT chuyển, nên câu này đặt ngay sau câu đó ở vị trí [3].
